title: Missed Appointments
about: The clinic's policy on missed and late appointments, for the patient to keep. Edit the times to match your clinic.

blocks.text: When you miss a visit, another patient could have had that time. Please help us keep visits open for everyone.
• If you cannot come, call us at {facility.phone} as soon as you know. Please call at least one day before if you can.
• If you are more than 15 minutes late, we may ask you to wait for an open time or to come another day.
• If you miss several visits without calling, we will talk with you about what would help. We may then offer you same-day visits only.
• We will remind you of your visits by the ways you choose. Please keep your phone number up to date.
If something makes it hard to get here, such as a ride or child care, please tell us. We may be able to help.
